messages:
violet: tiny friday ask  40-ish minute cassette-style mix (think lo-fi, acoustic, tiny city nights) + one short movie under 75min for porch watching. no stadium rock.
omar: quick mix i carried on a cassette once:
```
1. Nick Drake - Fruit Tree (3:20)
2. Sufjan Stevens - Casimir Pulaski Day (4:10)
3. José González - Crosses (3:12)
4. Laura Marling - Sophia (5:00)
5. Iron & Wine - Love and Some Verses (4:05)
6. Paul Simon - The Only Living Boy in New York (5:45)
7. The Microphones - I Want Wind to Blow (4:10)
8. Vashti Bunyan - Train Song (2:51)
```
~32-35 min, add soft repeats or a field recording outro to reach ~40.
ken: short film rec: "The Red Balloon" is under 35min and weirdly perfect for porch watching.
leah: or "A Ghost Story" is longer but quiet and meditative (just over 90, so not perfect). maybe skip it.
violet: vote: Red Balloon (:one:) or an indie short (:two:)? react :one/:two
ken: :one:
leah: :two: wanting something less whimsical
omar: :one: for absolutely charming nostalgia
violet: looks like Red Balloon wins. jukebox-bot, can you queue omar's cassette and post a link?
jukebox-bot: queued to #random-playlists (https://open.spotify/placeholder) and pinned "Red Balloon" link to #random-links. reminder set for 2024-06-20T20:00:00Z for porch watch. :cd::alarm_clock:
violet: i'll bring chamomile and an old blanket. tiny porch party, yep.
